_style: Detailed children's picture-book illustration, warm gouache and ink texture, rich saturated colours, soft lamp light, detail and texture spread across the whole picture (it will be cut into jigsaw pieces), respectful and authentic depiction of coastal Karnataka culture, no text, no letters, no watermark, no frame.

puzzles.y01_raja_vesha: A Yakshagana king (raja vesha) dancing on an open-air village stage at night: tall golden kireeta crown set with tiny mirrors, painted face with bold black eyebrows, layered gold chest and shoulder ornaments, red and gold costume with a full skirt; oil lamps at the stage edge, musicians faintly behind, villagers watching.
puzzles.y02_bannada_vesha: A Yakshagana bannada vesha (demon role) making a dramatic entry: huge wide headgear, bold red, white and black face paint patterns, arms raised, swirling dark costume with gold trim, a held-up curtain being dropped by two helpers, drummers in the background.
puzzles.y03_stri_vesha: A Yakshagana stri vesha performer playing a queen: bright silk saree, decorated hair-piece with flowers, delicate jewellery, graceful dance pose with expressive hands and eyes, warm stage lamps, musicians softly blurred behind.
puzzles.y04_hasyagara: A Yakshagana hasyagara (comic jester) in a simple costume and small turban, mid-joke on stage, a laughing village audience of children and elders sitting on mats in the foreground, oil lamps and night sky.
puzzles.y05_himmela: The Yakshagana himmela musicians at the back of the stage: the Bhagavata singer in the centre playing small hand cymbals, a maddale (barrel drum played by hand) player on one side and a chende (tall cylindrical drum played with sticks) player on the other, lamps and decorated stage cloth.
puzzles.y06_chowki: Backstage in a Yakshagana chowki (green room): performers sitting cross-legged at small mirrors painting their faces with bright colours from little bowls, crowns and ornaments laid on a mat, a brass oil lamp glowing before a small Ganesha picture, cosy and busy.
puzzles.y07_abhimanyu: Young warrior Abhimanyu in Yakshagana costume bravely charging into the chakravyuha, a spiral wheel-shaped formation of warriors with shields and banners around him, dynamic and heroic, child-friendly, no blood.
puzzles.y08_tala_maddale: A tala-maddale performance: men in white dhotis and shawls sitting in a semicircle on a mat in a temple hall, debating with expressive hand gestures, a singer with hand cymbals and a maddale drummer, brass lamps, attentive listeners.
puzzles.c01_pili_vesha: Pili vesha tiger dancers in a Navaratri street procession in Udupi: dancers' bodies painted with bright yellow, orange and black tiger stripes, leaping and rolling, tase drummers, colourful flags, cheering crowd, festive evening light.
puzzles.c02_rathotsava: A decorated wooden temple chariot (ratha) being pulled with thick ropes by a joyful crowd along a temple street in coastal Karnataka, flowers, flags and colourful cloth on the chariot, traditional tiled-roof houses, shown from outside, no idol visible.
puzzles.c03_harbour_boats: Dawn at a coastal Karnataka fishing harbour like Malpe: rows of colourful painted fishing boats, gulls, fishermen unloading baskets of silver fish, coconut palms, pink and gold sky reflected in the water.
puzzles.c04_mallige: Hands stringing fresh white Udupi mallige jasmine buds on thread at a market stall, heaps of jasmine strings and banana leaves, marigolds and a smiling flower seller in the background, morning light.

guide.vesha_idle: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a friendly cartoon child Yakshagana performer named Vesha with a small golden kireeta crown, red costume, gentle smile, looking at the viewer, plain light cream background, simple bold shapes, readable at small size.
guide.vesha_happy: The same friendly cartoon child Yakshagana performer with small golden kireeta crown and red costume, laughing happily with rosy cheeks, plain light cream background, simple bold shapes.
guide.vesha_think: The same friendly cartoon child Yakshagana performer with small golden kireeta crown and red costume, thinking with a finger on the chin, looking up, plain light cream background, simple bold shapes.
